requires.degrade: Without node, the disk-hygiene hooks cannot launch, so they do nothing.

Without Python 3.11 or newer, the guard denies hygiene.py calls, /disk-hygiene:clean cannot run, and /disk-hygiene:audit cannot scan. This check judges only the first of python3, python and py on PATH. The guard tries each in that order (py as py -3) and uses the first that passes its own probe, so when a later one is 3.11 or newer the guard still runs.
